name: flutterpay
description: A simulated payment gateway for learning backend development.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@flutterpay/api && npm run build --workspace=@flutterpay/sdk-node && npm run build --workspace=@flutterpay/dashboard && npm run build --workspace=@flutterpay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@flutterpay/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@flutterpay/sdk-node && npm run typecheck --workspace=@flutterpay/dashboard && npm run typecheck --workspace=@flutterpay/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@flutterpay/api && npm run test --workspace=@flutterpay/sdk-node && npm run test --workspace=@flutterpay/dashboard && npm run test --workspace=@flutterpay/web
